categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Tianyuan Dic Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software and information technology services, ICT product sales, and value-added services. Its main business segments include telecommunications industry BOSS systems, financial IT services and outsourcing, government and enterprise digital solutions, and ICT product distribution through subsidiaries. The company serves key sectors such as telecommunications, finance, government, and large enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including artificial intelligence (AI), big data, cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT), and information security. It develops proprietary software platforms, AI models, and intelligent automation tools such as AI anti-fraud models, intelligent call robots, and digital government platforms. Production methods emphasize software development, system integration, and ICT product distribution with a focus on innovation and digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese telecommunications operators (China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile), large state-owned and joint-stock banks, insurance companies, government agencies, and large enterprises. The company’s markets span telecommunications IT solutions, financial IT services and outsourcing, government digitalization, and ICT product sales for enterprise and government clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with subsidiaries and technical support centers in major cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hefei, Wuhan, Chengdu, Xi’an, and others. It also has presence in Hong Kong, Macau, and overseas markets through subsidiaries. Revenue is mainly generated from domestic regions with some overseas exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Tianyuan Dic operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT and telecommunications supply chain. It provides software development, system integration, IT services, and ICT product distribution, acting as a solutions provider and value-added reseller rather than a hardware manufacturer. It also engages in service outsourcing and digital transformation consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on enabling industrial digital transformation through continuous investment in AI, big data, cloud computing, and IoT. Key R&D initiatives include AI one-stop development platforms, intelligent solution generation, large model intelligent acceptance platforms, data security unified development, and multi-modal intelligent recognition platforms. It emphasizes AI native applications, intelligent automation, and integration with domestic technology ecosystems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, customized software development and services, system integration projects, IT outsourcing and intelligent operation services, and ICT product sales and value-added services. The company also earns revenue from operational business models such as revenue sharing with telecom operators and service fees from financial outsourcing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the telecommunications BOSS system market with over 20 years of experience and significant market share. It competes in the financial IT services sector with a growing client base among major banks and insurance firms. Its ICT product distribution subsidiary is a top-tier reseller for Huawei, Super Fusion, and DJI. The industry is competitive with many players, especially in financial IT, where product standardization and pricing pressure affect profitability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.16 billion, a 23.84% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 23.2 million, a decrease of 18.1%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.68 billion, growing 8.67% from the previous year. Despite profit fluctuations due to goodwill impairment and acquisitions, operating cash flow improved significantly, indicating enhanced operational quality.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep industry expertise, proprietary AI and big data technologies, and comprehensive digital transformation solutions tailored for telecommunications, finance, and government sectors. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated AI capabilities, extensive client relationships, and ability to deliver standardized yet customizable IT solutions. The company also highlights its strong brand reputation, innovation-driven culture, and strategic partnerships with leading technology vendors.
